sources.quote: The game's core content was created through extensive manual development. The main character, outfits, and all Live2D models are entirely hand-drawn, manually rigged, animated, and polished by the developer. AI was used only as a limited production aid for a small number of UI illustrations, some optional Gacha characters (which were extensively edited, layered, animated, and refined by hand), store images,and the soundtrack.
